requirements.text: For these tests, on request of the manufacturer and agreed by the technical service, either the impact speeds defined in paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. or the impact speed corresponding to the adjusted vehicle height shall be used.
requirements.quote: For these tests, on request of the manufacturer and agreed by the technical service, either the impact speeds defined in paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. or the impact speed corresponding to the adjusted vehicle height shall be used.

requirements.text: In the latter case, the ratio of the head impact vs. the corresponding vehicle velocity shall be 0.9.
requirements.quote: In the latter case, the ratio of the head impact vs. the corresponding vehicle velocity shall be 0.9.

requirements.text: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.
requirements.quote: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.

requirements.text: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.
requirements.quote: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.

requirements.text: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
requirements.quote: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall show that any devices will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.
requirements.quote: It shall be the responsibility of the manufacturer to show that any devices will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.

requirements.text: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.
requirements.quote: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position shall require the vehicle to comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.

requirements.text: The test laboratory shall carry out a minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.

requirements.text: The selected test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The selected test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.
requirements.quote: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.

requirements.text: The test laboratory shall carry out a minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The axis of the upper legform shall be vertical at the time of first contact.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance and the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance and the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that inadvertent maladjustment of the lamps shall not be possible.
requirements.quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.text: The illuminating lamps described in paragraphs 2.5.1., 2.5.2. and 2.5.10. shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.
requirements.quote: The illuminating lamps described in paragraphs 2.5.1., 2.5.2. and 2.5.10. shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road; in addition it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.
requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road; in addition it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.

requirements.text: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.
requirements.quote: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

requirements.text: The light-signalling devices shall comply with any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.);

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, except that this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.quote: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp;

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.

requirements.text: While lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, the lamps shall fulfill all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any.
requirements.quote: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The lamp shall fulfill the photometric and colorimetric requirements when all other functions with which the lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the other function(s) shall fulfill the requirements regarding colour when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: However, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis. These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis; or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that: (a) Either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.

requirements.text: When the photometric characteristics of any lamp vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, except for reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, the apparent surface of a white lamp shall have no direct visibility if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the visibility requirement for white light towards the rear of a vehicle shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.quote: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON, except that this requirement shall not apply to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON. This requirement shall not apply, however, to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the dipped-beam headlamps and/or the main-beam headlamps and/or the front fog lamps shall be such that in case of failure of any of these lighting devices the front position lamps are automatically switched ON again.
requirements.quote: Their electrical connections are such that in case of failure of any of these lighting devices the front position lamps are automatically switched ON again;

requirements.text: The substituting lamp/function shall meet, for the respective position lamp, the requirements concerning: (a) The geometric visibility prescribed for the front position lamps in 6.9.5; and (b) The minimum photometric values according to the angles of light distribution;
requirements.quote: The substituting lamp/function meets, for the respective position lamp, the requirements concerning: (a) The geometric visibility prescribed for the front position lamps in 6.9.5; and (b) The minimum photometric values according to the angles of light distribution;

requirements.text: Appropriate evidence demonstrating compliance with the requirements indicated in paragraph 5.12.1.2. above shall be provided in the test reports of the substituting lamp.
requirements.quote: Appropriate evidence demonstrating compliance with the requirements indicated in paragraph 5.12.1.2. above is provided in the test reports of the substituting lamp.

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, except that the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.quote: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.

requirements.text: The light emitted by the main-beam headlamp shall be White.
requirements.quote: Main-beam headlamp: White

requirements.text: The light emitted by the dipped-beam headlamp shall be White.
requirements.quote: Dipped-beam headlamp: White

requirements.text: The light emitted by the front fog lamp shall be White or selective yellow.
requirements.quote: Front fog lamp: White or selective yellow

requirements.text: The light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be White.
requirements.quote: Reversing lamp: White

requirements.text: The light emitted by the direction-indicator lamp shall be Amber.
requirements.quote: Direction-indicator lamp: Amber

requirements.text: The light emitted by the hazard warning signal shall be Amber.
requirements.quote: Hazard warning signal: Amber

requirements.text: The light emitted by the stop lamp shall be Red.
requirements.quote: Stop lamp: Red

requirements.text: The light emitted by the emergency stop signal shall be Amber or red.
requirements.quote: Emergency stop signal : Amber or red

requirements.text: The light emitted by the rear-end collision alert signal shall be Amber.
requirements.quote: Rear-end collision alert signal: Amber

requirements.text: The light emitted by the rear registration plate lamp shall be White.
requirements.quote: Rear registration plate lamp: White

requirements.text: The light emitted by the front position lamp shall be White.
requirements.quote: Front position lamp: White

requirements.text: The light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be Red.
requirements.quote: Rear position lamp: Red

requirements.text: The light emitted by the rear fog lamp shall be Red.
requirements.quote: Rear fog lamp: Red

requirements.text: The parking lamp shall be White in front, red at the rear, amber if reciprocally incorporated in the side direction-indicator lamps or in the side-marker lamps.
requirements.quote: Parking lamp: White in front, red at the rear, amber if reciprocally incorporated in the side direction-indicator lamps or in the side-marker lamps.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamp shall be Amber, except that the rearmost side-marker lamp can be red if it is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp or is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: Side-marker lamp: Amber; however the rearmost side- marker lamp can be red if it is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp or is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The light emitted by the end-outline marker lamp shall be White in front, red at the rear.
requirements.quote: End-outline marker lamp: White in front, red at the rear

requirements.text: The light emitted by the daytime running lamp shall be White.
requirements.quote: Daytime running lamp: White

requirements.text: The light returned by the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be Red.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red

requirements.text: The light returned by the rear retro-reflector, triangular, shall be Red.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, triangular: Red

requirements.text: The light returned by the front retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be identical to incident light8.
requirements.quote: Front retro-reflector, non- triangular: Identical to incident light8

requirements.text: The light returned by the side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be Amber, except that the rearmost side retro-reflector can be red if it is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear position lamp, the rear end outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop-lamp, the red rearmost side-marker lamp or the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular.
requirements.quote: Side retro-reflector, non- triangular: Amber; however the rearmost side retro-reflector can be red if it is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear position lamp, the rear end outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop-lamp, the red rearmost side-marker lamp or the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular.

requirements.text: The light emitted by the cornering lamp shall be White.
requirements.quote: Cornering lamp: White

requirements.text: The conspicuity marking shall be White to the front; White or yellow to the side; Red or yellow to the rear.
requirements.quote: Conspicuity marking: White to the front; White or yellow to the side; Red or yellow to the rear.

requirements.text: The light emitted by adaptive front-lighting systems (AFS) shall be White.
requirements.quote: Adaptive front-lighting systems (AFS): White

requirements.text: The light emitted by the exterior courtesy lamp shall be White.
requirements.quote: Exterior courtesy lamp: White

requirements.text: The exterior courtesy lamp shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the exterior courtesy lamp.
requirements.quote: Exterior courtesy lamp: In addition, in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the exterior courtesy lamp.

requirements.text: The light emitted by the manoeuvring lamp shall be White.
requirements.quote: Manoeuvring lamp: White

requirements.text: The answer-back signal shall be in accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.
requirements.quote: Answer-back signal: In accordance with the individual specifications applicable to the specific lamp used for the answer-back signal.

requirements.text: The light emitted by the reversing projection shall be White.
requirements.quote: Reversing projection: White

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The installation of any lamp on movable components shall fulfill the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20.
requirements.quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

requirements.text: If 0.15 per cent is exceeded, each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.
requirements.quote: If this value is exceeded each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

requirements.text: If the above requirement is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component;

requirements.text: If the above requirement is not practicable, a remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components.
requirements.quote: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components;

requirements.text: If the above requirement is not practicable, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
requirements.quote: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.

requirements.text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark shall be deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.quote: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.

requirements.text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.

requirements.text: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, the light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23. above.
requirements.quote: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23. above.

requirements.text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.quote: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.

requirements.text: When electric power supply conditions are not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.quote: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

requirements.text: When installed on a vehicle, all lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be Number Two Class “F3” and type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.
requirements.quote: Number Two Class “F3” and type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be positioned so that that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: In height: Minimum: Not less than 250 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the front fog lamp shall be not more than 800 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: Maximum: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: not more than 800 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: For all other categories except N3G (off-road)12 vehicles, the front fog lamp shall be not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: For all other categories except N3G (off-road)12 vehicles: not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: For category N3G vehicles, the front fog lamp shall be not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that the maximum height may be increased to 1,500 mm.
requirements.quote: For category N3G vehicles: the maximum height may be increased to 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: No point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp.
requirements.quote: No point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be at the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: at the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be deemed to be satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly, or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall be deemed to be satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly, or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall have geometric visibility defined by angles α and ß as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 5° upwards and downwards, ß = 45° outwards and 10° inwards.
requirements.quote: Geometric visibility Defined by angles α and ß as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 5° upwards and downwards, ß = 45° outwards and 10° inwards.

requirements.text: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.
requirements.quote: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be oriented toward the front.
requirements.quote: Orientation Toward the front.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall have the vertical inclination of the cut-off set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver´s seat as – 1.0 per cent or lower.
requirements.quote: The vertical inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver´s seat shall be – 1.0 per cent or lower.

requirements.text: Depending on the mounting height in metres (h) of the lower edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front fog lamp, measured on the unladen vehicles, the front fog lamp shall have the vertical inclination of the cut-off automatically remain between the following values under all the static conditions of Annex 5: h ≤ 0.8 Limits: between -1.0 per cent and -3.0 per cent Initial aiming: between -1.5 per cent and -2.0 per cent h > 0.8 Limits: between -1.5 per cent and -3.5 per cent Initial aiming: between -2.0 per cent and -2.5 per cent.
requirements.quote: Depending on the mounting height in metres (h) of the lower edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the front fog lamp, measured on the unladen vehicles, the vertical inclination of the cut-off shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between the following values: h ≤ 0.8 Limits: between -1.0 per cent and -3.0 per cent Initial aiming: between -1.5 per cent and -2.0 per cent h > 0.8 Limits: between -1.5 per cent and -3.5 per cent Initial aiming: between -2.0 per cent and -2.5 per cent.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall have the initial downward inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat specified within an accuracy of one decimal place by the manufacturer and indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. by the symbol shown in Annex 7 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be specified within an accuracy of one decimal place by the manufacturer and indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. by the symbol shown in Annex 7 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall have the value of this indicated downward inclination defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
requirements.quote: The value of this indicated downward inclination shall be defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.

requirements.text: Where a levelling device is fitted for a front fog lamp, independent or grouped with other front lighting and light signalling functions, the front fog lamp levelling device shall be such that the vertical inclination, under all the static loading conditions of Annex 5 of this Regulation, shall remain between the limits prescribed in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
requirements.quote: Where a levelling device is fitted for a front fog lamp, independent or grouped with other front lighting and light signalling functions, it shall be such that the vertical inclination, under all the static loading conditions of Annex 5 of this Regulation, shall remain between the limits prescribed in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.

requirements.text: If the front fog lamp is part of the dipped-beam headlamp or is part of an AFS system, the requirements of paragraph 6.2.6. shall be applied during the use of the front fog beam as part of the dipped beam.
requirements.quote: In the case where the front fog lamp is part of the dipped-beam headlamp or is part of an AFS system, the requirements of paragraph 6.2.6. shall be applied during the use of the front fog beam as part of the dipped beam.

requirements.text: In the case of a failure of the levelling device, the front fog beam shall not assume a position in which the cut off is less inclined than it was at the time when the failure of the device occurred.
requirements.quote: In the case of a failure of the levelling device, the front fog beam shall not assume a position in which the cut off is less inclined than it was at the time when the failure of the device occurred.

requirements.text: The front fog lamps shall be switchable ON and OFF independently of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps or any combination of main- and dipped-beam headlamps, except that the front fog lamps are used as part of another lighting function in an AFS, in which case the switching ON of the front fog lamps function shall have the priority over the function for which the front fog lamps are used as a part, or the front fog lamps cannot be simultaneously lit with any other lamps with which they are reciprocally incorporated as indicated by the relevant symbol ("/") according to paragraph 10.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. 19. or item 9.5.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. [RID].
requirements.quote: It shall be possible to switch the front fog lamps ON and OFF independently of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps or any combination of main- and dipped-beam headlamps, unless: (a) The front fog lamps are used as part of another lighting function in an AFS; however, the switching ON of the front fog lamps function shall have the priority over the function for which the front fog lamps are used as a part, or (b) The front fog lamps cannot be simultaneously lit with any other lamps with which they are reciprocally incorporated as indicated by the relevant symbol ("/") according to paragraph 10.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. 19. or item 9.5.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. [RID].

requirements.text: The front fog lamps shall have a closed-circuit tell-tale.
requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.

requirements.text: Any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment of the front fog beam shall be performed automatically and in such a way that no discomfort, neither for the driver nor to other road users, is caused.
requirements.quote: Any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment shall be performed automatically and in such a way that no discomfort, neither for the driver nor to other road users, is caused.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be fitted on all motor vehicles.
requirements.quote: Mandatory on all motor vehicles.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be fitted on trailers over 1,600 mm wide.
requirements.quote: Mandatory on trailers over 1,600 mm wide.

requirements.text: The front position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall have that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In the case of a trailer, the front position lamp shall have that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the median longitudinal plane not more than 150 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In the case of a trailer, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 150 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For all other categories of vehicles, the front position lamp shall have the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: Not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm, except that 2,100 mm applies for O1 and O2 categories of vehicles, or if for any other categories of vehicles the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm.
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm for O1 and O2 categories of vehicles, or if for any other categories of vehicles the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).

requirements.text: Where the front position lamp and another lamp are reciprocally incorporated, the front position lamp shall use the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the other lamp to verify compliance with the positioning requirements (paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3.).
requirements.quote: Where the front position lamp and another lamp are reciprocally incorporated, the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the other lamp shall be used to verify compliance with the positioning requirements (paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3.).

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane, and in the case of trailers, the angle inwards may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane. In the case of trailers, the angle inwards may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the front position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle: Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the front position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the front position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm2, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
requirements.quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm2. The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be oriented forwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Forwards.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall have electrical connections in accordance with paragraph 5.11., except that if a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator the electrical connection of the front position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.quote: Electrical connections In accordance with paragraph 5.11. However, if a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator the electrical connection of the front position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall have a closed-circuit tell-tale.
requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall have a tell-tale that shall be non-flashing and shall not be required if the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON simultaneously with the front position lamps, except that this requirement does not apply while the daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: This tell-tale shall be non-flashing and shall not be required if the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON simultaneously with the front position lamps. This requirement does not apply while the daytime running lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall have a tell-tale indicating failure if required by the component regulation.
requirements.quote: However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.

requirements.text: If one or more infrared radiation generator(s) is (are) installed inside the front position lamp, the infrared radiation generator(s) shall be switched ON only when the headlamp on the same side of the vehicle is switched ON and the vehicle is in forward motion.
requirements.quote: If one or more infrared radiation generator(s) is (are) installed inside the front position lamp, it (they) is (are) allowed to be switched ON only when the headlamp on the same side of the vehicle is switched ON and the vehicle is in forward motion.

requirements.text: In the event that the front position lamp or the headlamp on the same side fails, the infrared radiation generator(s) shall be automatically switched OFF.
requirements.quote: In the event that the front position lamp or the headlamp on the same side fails, the infrared radiation generator(s) shall be automatically switched OFF.

requirements.text: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.

requirements.text: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.

requirements.text: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.quote: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: The outward facing angles of parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: The hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.
requirements.quote: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.

requirements.text: The provisions of the above paragraphs 5.1. to 5.5. shall apply in addition to the particular specifications of the following paragraph 6., except where these particular specifications expressly provide otherwise.
requirements.quote: The provisions of the above paragraphs 5.1. to 5.5. shall apply in addition to the particular specifications of the following paragraph 6., except where these particular specifications expressly provide otherwise.

requirements.text: The projecting visors and rims on headlights shall have projection, as measured in relation to the external transparent surface of the headlight does not exceed 30 mm and their radius of curvature is at least 2.5 mm throughout.
requirements.quote: Projecting visors and rims shall be permitted on headlights, provided that their projection, as measured in relation to the external transparent surface of the headlight does not exceed 30 mm and their radius of curvature is at least 2.5 mm throughout.

requirements.text: In the case of a headlamp mounted behind an additional transparent surface, the projection shall be measured from the outermost transparent surface.
requirements.quote: In the case of a headlamp mounted behind an additional transparent surface, the projection shall be measured from the outermost transparent surface.

requirements.text: The projections shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 3. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The projections shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 3. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: Where the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose, the requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles.
requirements.quote: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. above shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.

requirements.text: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.
requirements.quote: For gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.

requirements.text: If the distance between two consecutive elements is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.
requirements.quote: However, if the distance between two consecutive elements is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.

requirements.text: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.
requirements.quote: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.

requirements.text: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling, and this requirement is considered to be satisfied if either the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork or the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.
requirements.quote: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling. This requirement is considered to be satisfied if either the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork or the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.

requirements.text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases, and this provision shall apply to that part of the zone lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward which is situated between and in front (or rear in case of the rear bumper) of tangential points with the contour line of two vertical planes each forming with the longitudinal plane of symmetry of the vehicle an angle of 15° (see Fig. 1).
requirements.quote: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases. This provision applies to that part of the zone lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward which is situated between and in front (or rear in case of the rear bumper) of tangential points with the contour line of two vertical planes each forming with the longitudinal plane of symmetry of the vehicle an angle of 15° (see Fig. 1). requirements.text: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above shall not apply to parts on or of the bumper or to bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers, except that the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.quote: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above shall not apply to parts on or of the bumper or to bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers; but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above shall not apply to the bumper cover.
requirements.quote: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. above does not apply to the bumper cover.

requirements.text: The bumper cover shall comply with the provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation remain applicable.

requirements.text: If they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation, the supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation if they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the following requirements:
requirements.quote: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the following requirements:

requirements.text: The lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible.
requirements.quote: The lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible.

requirements.text: The vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner; in addition, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.

requirements.text: The side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner; in addition, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.

requirements.text: The vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning.
requirements.quote: The vehicle’s fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning; their sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.

requirements.text: The vehicle's sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.quote: The vehicle’s fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning; their sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.

requirements.text: The vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.

requirements.text: The vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner, except that this requirement does not apply to sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems.
requirements.quote: The vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner. This requirement does not apply to sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems. They may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.

requirements.text: Where the vehicle has a lower bumper height of less than 425 mm, the vehicle shall meet the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1.

regulations.rationale: The integrated front fog lamps are road-illumination devices covered by R149, the consolidated successor to legacy R19. (lexical: term match score 7.3)
The integrated front position lamps are light-signalling devices; R148 is the consolidated device regulation replacing legacy R7 for this purpose. (lexical: term match score 2.4)

The module contains electrical/electronic sub-assemblies, notably ultrasonic parking sensors, wiring and lamp electronics; EMC requirements apply to ESAs intended for M1 vehicles. (lexical: term match score 10.8)
Applies to M1 pedestrian safety; the front bumper cover, beam and absorber are in the lower-leg impact zone and must support vehicle compliance. (lexical: term match score 8.2)

When installed on the M1 vehicle, the front fog lamps and front position lamps must comply with lighting-installation requirements for position, visibility, electrical connection and tell-tales. (lexical: term match score 7.9)
The bumper cover, lamp/sensor openings and front exterior surfaces are external projections of an M1 vehicle and must meet the relevant exterior safety requirements. (lexical: term match score 5.7)
The product is a front protective device/bumper system for an M1 vehicle and is intended to provide low-speed impact protection. (lexical: term match score 2.4)
